initialExam.title: Indian Navy SSC Officer 2026
initialExam.description: Short Service Commission Officer entry in the Indian Navy for graduates and post-graduates. SSC officers serve for an initial period of 10 years, extendable by 4 years.
initialExam.eligibility: B.E/B.Tech or equivalent for Technical; Graduate for other branches
initialExam.qualifications: Engineering degree for Technical; Any degree for Executive/Education branch
initialExam.syllabus: SSB Interview: Officer Intelligence Rating, Picture Perception, Group Testing, Psychology Tests, Personal Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Shortlisting based on academics. SSB Interview: 5 days.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Application → Shortlisting → SSB Interview (5 days) → Medical → Merit → Training at INA
initialExam.jobRole: Sub Lieutenant in Indian Navy (Technical/Executive/Education branch)
initialExam.careerGrowth: Sub Lieutenant → Lieutenant → Lieutenant Commander → Commander (if granted permanent commission).
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit joinindiannavy.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. SSB Interview 5. Medical
initialExam.perks: MSP, DA, Kit allowance, Free accommodation, Medical, CSD, Subsidized rations, Leave Travel
